features:
Key Features:

Made with 100% whole grain rice — provides approximately 17g of whole grains per serving.

Certified gluten-free — safe for individuals with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

Low in fat and sugar — typically around 0.5g fat and 2g sugar per serving.

Fortified with essential nutrients such as iron, calcium, vitamin D, and B-vitamins (B1, B2, B6, folic acid, B12).

No artificial flavors or colors, no high-fructose corn syrup, and preserved with natural vitamin E.

Benefits:

Gluten-free safety: A reliable breakfast option for those with dietary restrictions.

Light and easy to digest: Low in fat and sugar, making it ideal for a heart-healthy lifestyle.

Nutrient-rich: Fortified to help meet daily requirements for iron and key vitamins.

Versatile use: Can be eaten with milk, yogurt, or turned into homemade snacks and recipes like cereal bars or party mix.

Kid-friendly and allergy-conscious: Minimal ingredients make it simple and safe for many diets.
ingredients: Whole Grain Rice, Rice, Sugar, Salt, Molasses. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Tricalcium Phosphate, Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
